unit: distinct new lemma_proposed ID on the official feed, matching the formal mathematical claim; cosmetic re-filings excluded
falsification: Each claim fails if no qualifying new row is posted during the stated window. If the public feed is unavailable, evaluation is unobserved. Desk availability is reported separately.

forecast.family: Edge circuits for larger families of forests
forecast.criterion: A newly proposed lemma states an exact circuit-size family for forests with at least eight vertices including a disconnected example, or for trees with at least nine vertices. A single additional example already subsumed by L-meta-902/903 does not count; a stronger general classification does.
forecast.asset: Existing forest certificate generator and verified spider proof. Add a canonical isomorphism representative and disjoint-component shape fixture at the next order.

forecast.family: Gate lower bounds for incidence systems with few negations
forecast.criterion: A newly proposed lemma either instantiates a positive few-NOT lower bound for a finite plane of order at least 11, or explicitly allows both some NOT gates and outputs accepting only specified proper subsets of the incident points in its theorem. It must state a new mathematical bound. A check of L-meta-745 or another numerical case at order 8 or 9 does not count.
forecast.asset: A parameterized finite-plane difference-set/counter for projective incidence, followed separately by a symbolic verification of the bound and its hypotheses.

forecast.judgment: moderate for research feed, lower for a prompt on the public desk
forecast.criterion: A newly proposed lemma either gives a concrete lower bound on the AND count of the maximal-independent-set partial function for a graph on at least eight vertices, or gives a new transformation that lowers a broader class of such instances to smaller graphs with an explicit additive cost. The posted isolate, disjoint-edge and tight-union rules, including mere restatements, do not count.
forecast.asset: Enumerate the maximal independent sets and their one-vertex extensions from a graph. Pair that specification with a proof for every circuit below the proposed AND budget; truth-table verification of a candidate upper bound is a different certificate.
